watches.condition: Published technical specification gives smaller pitch or defect detection limit than last authoritative version
watches.failure_mode: Vendor specification is not measured production yield

watches.condition: First customer mass-production qualification, or new repeat order with identified delivery period
watches.confirmations_needed: independent customer when possible; reconcile incremental vs cumulative order value
watches.failure_mode: Purchase order not equal recognized profit

watches.condition: Independent manufacturer discloses volume qualification by generation + corresponding test requirements
watches.confirmations_needed: specific HBM generation and production dates
watches.failure_mode: HBM4 launch does not imply all stacks use hybrid bonding

watches.condition: Published standard status changes Active PAR/draft -> ratified AND details alter lane requirements
watches.confirmations_needed: IEEE official document and effective date
watches.failure_mode: Draft amendment cannot be treated as final

watches.condition: Customer independently confirms completed 1.6T qualification or volume shipments with measured thermal/power budget
watches.failure_mode: Joint development or sample forecast is not mass production

watches.condition: Named hyperscaler publicly chooses CPO/pluggable platform and explains deployment scope
Official OCP LVDC paper or sidecar reference architecture revision changes voltage/protection interface
watches.confirmations_needed: official spec revision and changed requirements
watches.failure_mode: Working-group proposal does not imply customers switched

watches.condition: Independent operator publicly confirms deployed native 800VDC direct-MVAC solution and supplier identities
watches.failure_mode: Pilot tests do not prove widespread adoption
